capabilities: Add tags matching a note's folder to frontmatter
Update tags when notes are moved or renamed
Configure folder depth and tag formatting with prefix or suffix
Reapply or remove folder tags across all notes
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The README says it is ideal for users who organize notes by folder but want to leverage tags for easier searching, linking, and graph view.
problem: Users who organize notes by folders can't use tags for search, links, and graph view without manually keeping the tags in sync with folder locations.
summary: Plugin that automatically adds tags matching a note's folder path to its frontmatter and keeps them updated when notes move.
